name: Shamen The Remission of Sins
original_name: 赦免 The remission of sins
source:
――「Thank you very much.
This exhibition is composed only of expressions that may induce mental anxiety of customers.
Are you physically and mentally healthy now?」――

Exhibited "Select [forgiveness] or [kill]" for the five men and women....
What kind of effect does such an act have on the fate of the protagonist?
